problem: A plan cannot contain the digest of its own final bytes through proposed row evidence; actual accepted_at cannot be fixed before the transition review is delivered and then described as the actual later application time.
scope_delta: Clarify the existing exact-row requirement as a completely frozen stable-row plus exactly two enumerated, independently reviewed resolver slots. No additional source path or canonical field permission is introduced.

plan_representation.canonical_hash_rule: Strict JSON rejects duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers. Hash a documented canonical UTF-8 serialization, including all keys, arrays and exact strings; retain raw file SHA separately. The helper version and exact source SHA define the resolver and encoding, not a mutable prose-only convention.
plan_representation.frozen_fields: The complete proposed W04 row, including identities/status/start time/note, exact new three roots, all original non-root evidence in order and archive ref, is frozen in a stable-row template. All canonical fields outside W04 row and metadata fields already authorized by the original scope remain protected by the original CAS and preservation constraints.

slots.name: self_plan_ref
slots.location: One precisely specified final element of W04 row evidence
slots.resolution: Append exactly this plan's repository-relative path and SHA256 of the actual frozen plan raw bytes. No other evidence insertion/removal/reordering. The template contains a reserved tagged slot, never a fake digest and never a live canonical row.

slots.name: actual_apply_time
slots.resolution: Only Root apply may select an actual current UTC timestamp after verifying both real Root delivery envelopes: the new independent product acceptance and independent transition-plan review. It must be >= both received_at values and all prior execution/context/review/issuance times required by the unchanged reader. A prepare time, review time, planned future time or old accepted_at is not valid.

plan_representation.closed_world: No additional placeholder, environment substitution, implicit default, arbitrary JSON Pointer or dynamic row field is allowed. Missing/duplicate/unknown slots fail closed. The stable-row canonical hash signs the exact slot locations and resolver semantics.

must_bind: Exact frozen plan_ref path/raw SHA and stable-row canonical hash
Exact reviewed register.py SHA and resolver protocol version/encoding
Exact old canonical raw hashes and complete archived W04 row/root/delivery chain
Exact new applicability vector and complete new execution/review/Root delivery/issuance chain
Exact removed three roots and added three roots; preservation of all old non-root references
Both resolver slots and all invariants above, with explicit deferred final-time verification
independent_transition_review.time_semantics: The independent review authorizes a bounded state transition, not a future fully resolved row timestamp. Do not claim that a complete final row containing actual accepted_at was already observed at plan-review time.
independent_transition_review.delivery: Root must actually receive a plan-bound independent message and retain its original content/envelope with plan/review hashes and actual observation locator. Self-authored JSON consistency is not delivery authentication.
independent_transition_review.no_cycle: Do not put this transition review's own hash or its observed message into the proposed row. The later commit receipt links plan, transition review, both real Root messages and resolved row. Plan-ref append alone provides the row-to-plan link without cyclic hashing.

apply_order: 1 Under the serial Root writer lease, reread exact actual canonical raw bytes and independently verified plan/source/messages. Check original CAS and frozen applicability inputs. Refuse any unresolved old/new chain, semantic conflict, source drift or extra root.

2 Reconstruct the reviewed stable row and require its exact canonical hash and all fields to match the transition review. Compute actual frozen plan_ref. Validate both actual received-message chains and select actual Root apply time now; enforce the complete time ordering.

3 Resolve only the two slots. Persist immutable intent containing complete resolved proposed row, raw/canonical row hashes, chosen apply time and all input references before canonical writes. The intent is PENDING, not an acceptance receipt.

4 Apply only the authorized row/metadata diffs using the original serial lease, per-write CAS, atomic file replacement and append-only recovery journal. Compare the actually serialized and read-back full row to the resolved row, not merely status or root IDs. Never overwrite a foreign modification during failure recovery.

5 Run unchanged registered validation and formal reader on the actual row, preserve raw outcomes, recheck all source/evidence/canonical inputs and produce immutable commit receipt containing full final row/hash, actual times and links to plan/review/messages/intent. Completion marker only after successful checks; no product or formal success from a pending journal.

6 Independent registered-stage verification reads the actual final row and commit receipt, recomputes both slot resolutions, time order and complete row hash, and confirms unchanged registered reader results. Only this closes the deferred final-row/time check. Preserve all former active roots and original receipt bytes.
required_negative_controls: Any template field change outside the two signed slots; appended alternate plan path/hash; duplicate or third resolver slot; changed evidence order
Changed helper/resolver or encoding after review; changed plan raw SHA; missing or mismatched actual Root message
accepted_at from prepare/review time or before either actual delivery; future timestamp supplied by caller instead of runtime clock
Concurrent canonical change after preparation or during apply; foreign target during recovery; partial transaction without completion marker
Commit receipt resolved row hash differs from actual canonical row; valid status/root IDs with altered non-root history or identities
unchanged_safeguards: This is current-applicability revalidation with preserved prior acceptance; it does not add v1 semantic supersession support or resolve conflicting verdicts for one unchanged vector.

The protected 51719-byte formal_case_index.py prefix and frozen gates/thresholds remain unchanged. The generic W04 reader does not authenticate historical transition semantics; the reviewed transition plus independent registered audit must do so explicitly.

Any future commands revision or captured validator/source change makes prior A05 applicability stale. Preserve old A05 proof/review and re-collect on the final stable MAIN vector with native dispatches and GLOBAL context; never patch old proof or assert fixture-only CURRENT.
This is internal scope clarification under existing ongoing user authorization. No new external user approval is required.
